event_description: User creates a new planning poker game room from the home page.
User joins an existing game room by submitting their name on the join screen.
Player selects or deselects a card to cast their vote during a voting round.
Cards are revealed to all players, ending the current voting phase.
A new voting round is started after cards have been revealed.
User copies the room invite link to share with teammates.
Server-side: a new poker room is successfully initialized via the API.
